column1: # selfhost-optbench: stage-1 compiles src/mcc.c with the flag set; stage-2 is the mcc that comes out, compiling src/mcc.c at -O2.
# cost = stage-1 instructions retired (compile-time price). gain = reduction in stage-2 instructions retired (payoff).
# all-on: cost 3.5901G gain-work 9.1022G   all-off: cost 2.6129G gain-work 8.9194G
# noise floor cost 0.0050% gain 0.0050%; shapley perms=24 seed=20260807
#   O1-new     n=16  cycles 3.3690G  insns 8.9212G  IPC 2.648  spread 1.068%
#   O1-now     n=16  cycles 3.3669G  insns 8.9211G  IPC 2.650  spread 1.686%
#   O2-new     n=41  cycles 3.3292G  insns 9.0599G  IPC 2.721  spread 1.084%
#   O2-now     n=41  cycles 3.3328G  insns 9.0599G  IPC 2.718  spread 1.045%
#   O3-new     n=47  cycles 3.3137G  insns 9.1023G  IPC 2.747  spread 1.096%
#   O3-now     n=47  cycles 3.3244G  insns 9.1023G  IPC 2.738  spread 0.915%
#   all-off    n= 0  cycles 3.3491G  insns 8.9194G  IPC 2.663  spread 1.080%
#   all-on     n=47  cycles 3.3257G  insns 9.1022G  IPC 2.737  spread 2.094%

# level rule: ranked and efficiency >= 1.000 -> -O1; >= 0.100 -> -O2; ranked otherwise -> -O3; not ranked and stage-1 cost >= 5% -> -O3, >= 50% -> off the ladder (level 9); not ranked otherwise -> unchanged.
# a flag is RANKED only if its sampled marginal gain clears two standard errors of its own sampling spread; nothing else is given a gain/cost ratio.
